discoveries.hypothesis: Recurring trajectory shapes separate forward 20d outcomes.
discoveries.test: chronological train/embargo/test, rank correlation of archetype outcome ordering
discoveries.notes: Outcome ordering does not persist out of sample.

discoveries.hypothesis: Discovered market states separate forward outcomes.
discoveries.test: chronological split, rank correlation of state outcome ordering

adversarial.reason: Rank correlation changes sign across seeds and/or the state changes at nearly every observation, so the apparent ordering is not a property of the data.

discoveries.notes: Single-config rank_corr was +0.8; the seed sweep turns it to -0.2 on identical data and the state changes at nearly every observation.

discoveries.hypothesis: Agreement/conflict across independent views separates outcomes.
discoveries.test: chronological split, aligned vs conflicted separation and sign persistence
discoveries.notes: Separation does not hold with a consistent sign out of sample.

discoveries.method: kNN on trajectory shape, ticker-excluded and embargoed
discoveries.hypothesis: Historical analogues of a pre-state predict its forward outcome.
discoveries.test: Spearman(twin mean outcome, actual outcome) across held-out queries

result.note: Near-zero twin-mean dispersion means the neighbourhoods are interchangeable and the analogue carries no signal.

discoveries.notes: Twin-mean carries no rank information about the actual outcome.

discoveries.method: rolling correlation graph, greedy modularity communities
discoveries.hypothesis: Relational community structure is real AND carries forward-return information beyond the market.
discoveries.test: ARI vs shuffled null for structure; leave-target-out peer-minus-market rank correlation for information
discoveries.notes: STRUCTURE CONFIRMED (z=70.21 vs null) but it carries no forward information: once the market term is subtracted the community effect is indistinguishable from zero. Real structure is not the same thing as a usable signal.

discoveries.method: entry offset t-3..t+3 on sealed R2 entries
discoveries.hypothesis: R2 losses are driven by entry TIMING rather than selection.
discoveries.notes: Bounded by sealed R2 memory (2 date units), NOT by price history.
